Quirks.description: The quirk switches. Absent fields take the original's behaviour.

absorber_contact_no_capacity_recheck.description: An infantry entrant that reaches an absorbing building goes in whatever the passenger count, the switch or its size, so with two or more link places the building can hold more than its capacity; off: at completion the building applies claim 1's acceptance test again, and a refused entrant is treated as a refused vehicle.

absorber_release_bridge_ends_search.description: When the eighth direction of the first round of an absorbing building's exit search passes both cell tests but its neighbour cell carries a bridge deck, the second round never starts and the passenger stays inside this processing; off: the second round starts as after any other failure at the eighth direction.

absorber_release_second_round_skips_rear.description: The second round of an absorbing building's exit search does not try the rear direction; off: the second round tries the rear direction first.

absorber_removal_keeps_stale_power.description: A passenger removed while inside an absorbing building does not make the building owner's power due, so the owner's totals keep its contribution until something else makes them due; off: the removal makes the building owner's power due, as a release does, when the type's extra output is above 0.

absorber_stale_contact_kept.description: An actor that stops being in *enter* with its contact with an absorbing building intact keeps the building's link place for good, so every later entrant waits in line for ever; off: in its own turn, after its movement, an actor in contact with an absorbing building that has neither *enter* current nor *enter* queued gives the contact up (the window in which a waiting actor has been granted contact and has *enter* queued but not yet started keeps it).

aim_origin_without_target.description: A shot fired with no current target aims at the world origin.

air_death_fall_generic_follow_up.description: The falling air death has the generic completion follow-up.

air_unload_reselects_clear_destination.description: An air transport's unload replaces a destination that passes the landing test (S-0501 claim 40's F7) by the replacement search around map waypoint 700, and takes the height-based approach or reselect transition for one that fails it; off: only a failing destination is replaced, and a passing one takes the approach or reselect transition.

airborne_deploy_order_dropped.description: A deploy order to an airborne in-place deploying type without the deploy-to-land flag is silently dropped; off: the order is kept until the vehicle is on the ground, and the next processing takes the ground deploy step of claim 4. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

airborne_mutation_hit_raised.description: An airborne infantry unit hit by a warhead of infantry-death kind 9 takes 0, which the defences raise to 1.

aircraft_corner_sector_untracked.description: An aircraft in flight that is not tracked and whose cell lies in sector (0, 0) of S-0303's F7, cell (0, 0) included, joins no flying-object list until it moves into another sector, so neither area damage nor the airborne scan finds it there; off: at its first movement update with a positive carried speed fraction it joins the end of sector (0, 0)'s list.

aircraft_edge_hold.description: An aircraft that may leave the map now and lacks the fly-by flag is pushed back at the legal map's boundary, with the side rule and the fallback draw, so with the fly-back flag (or where the usable area's boundary lies on or beyond the legal map's) it is never removed there; off: it is not pushed back, takes no candidate and no draw, and is removed in the update tick in which its position leaves the legal map.

aircraft_endless_refire.description: With the re-approach flag off, an ordinary non-fighter, non-strafer repeats burst-plus-single-shot cycles without spending its pending round; off: each such cycle ends as one run.

aircraft_half_reload_with_target.description: An aircraft on a pad with a target is never reloaded past half its ammunition while it keeps the target; off: reload to full regardless of target.

aircraft_released_above_pad.description: A factory release whose docking position lies above the terrain under it leaves the aircraft resting in the air, in neither cell layer and not tracked, and its first movement update descends; released at most 20 leptons up, it reaches height 0 there and, on a move, takes off at the move's first processing, before its second movement update; off: the release puts it at the docking position's horizontal location at the landing height above the terrain there, listed in its cell layer like an aircraft docked by landing, holding the object-present flag in that cell, and it leaves by an ordinary take-off at the order, which steers it toward its destination.

aircraft_smoke_scenario_draw.description: An aircraft's damage-smoke chance draws from the scenario stream, including updates that show no smoke; off: no damage-smoke draw and no smoke animation.

aircraft_threat_stays_put.description: An aircraft's threat and corridor exemption stay where it was placed.

aircraft_unit_step_stall.description: A forward step of exactly 1 lepton at a body facing between east and south (facings 16391 to 32766) changes neither coordinate, because each coordinate is truncated and no remainder is kept, so an aircraft slowing toward its destination can hover there with a positive fraction (an ordinary attacker never fires, a move or a return to a pad stops short of landing); off: a forward step of at least 1 lepton that would change neither coordinate moves 1 lepton along the axis of its larger component, in that component's direction, x on equal magnitudes.

aircraft_zero_step_attack_stall.description: An ordinary attacker reaches firing from approaching only at a current speed fraction of exactly 0, so one hovering with a positive fraction whose forward step truncates to 0 leptons never fires; off: a positive fraction with step length 0 also moves it to firing, keeping its destination, with the same 1-tick delay.

airstrike_empty_strike_stuck.description: A strike start that places no aircraft (an elite strike size of 0 or less, or a first aircraft that cannot be created) still leaves the strike in progress, so no aircraft can ever end it and later designations only redirect it; off: such a start leaves the strike idle, with its strike target and end tick unchanged.

airstrike_recharge_same_target_only.description: The recharge delay holds back only a repeat designation of the same object with no change of target in between, so a cancelled or redirected idle strike is ready at once for any object; off: an idle strike that has ended before is ready only when t ≥ e + R, whatever its target.

all_carriers_without_carrier.description: An all-carriers tag with no carrier never fires; off: a carrier count of 0 counts like 1, so the tag fires once and is deleted.

anim_damage_starts_at_one.description: A damaging animation's damage accumulator starts at 1.0, so its first advance already delivers 1 when δ < 1; off: it starts at 0.0. Implemented for the burning walker's expiring advances (S-0615 claim 11), the only animation the simulation plays with damage.

anim_fast_rate_freezes.description: A rate above 900 converts to a stage delay of ⌊900 / ρ⌋ = 0, so the animation never advances or ends through playback; off: a positive rate gives max(1, ⌊900 / ρ⌋). Rates of 0 or below give 0 in both settings. Built for the random-rate conversion of an animation's creation draw (S-0109 claim 3) and the playback of infantry-making animations in the simulation (S-0611 claim 8); the S-0517 claim 7 deploy delay is not implemented yet.

anim_fixed_upper_vertical_speed.description: A sprite type's upper vertical speed key is not read: F1 always uses 3.5 for the upper vertical limit; off: F1 uses the type's upper vertical speed field.

anim_followup_keeps_step.description: The step keeps its sign at a follow-up switch; off: it is set afresh from the reversed test.

anim_followup_start_doubled.description: A follow-up type starts at k = a'; off: at its own k0 of F3.

anim_loop_count_wrap.description: The remaining-pass count of an animation is taken modulo 256 and 255 means endless; off: an unbounded count, endless for a negative loop count.

anim_loop_end_from_sprite.description: An absent loop end takes the sprite end; off: it takes the end field.

anim_pingpong_lower_turn.description: While r >= 2 a ping-pong animation's lower turn compares k with the start field; off: k <= loop start less the start field.

anim_random_rate_collapse.description: A converted random rate pair is clamped to [min(d₁, max(d₂, 0)), max(d₂, 0)], so an ascending pair collapses to its faster end and takes no draw; off: the converted pair is put in order and the delay is a ranged draw over [min(d₁, d₂), max(d₁, d₂)], with no draw when they are equal. Changes the number of draws.

anim_resource_no_growth_entry.description: A bouncing animation's new resource cell joins neither of S-0401's lists; off: it is offered to its tiberium's growth list.

anim_resource_spread_neighbours_only.description: A resource-spreading animation's radius selects pairs but the cell depends only on the pair's first number, so at most the eight neighbours receive resource and the landing cell never does; off: the pair (i, j) offers the cell (X + i, Y + j), in the same order.

anim_reverse_raw_loop_end.description: A reversed animation starts at the loop end less one, restarts at the loop end and ends its pass at k <= 0; off: it starts and restarts at the loop end less the start field less one and ends its pass at k < 0.

announcement_volume_ignored.description: An announcement's volume key has no effect; off: the volume (a fraction, default 1) scales it.

approach_alternative_outside_area.description:
A vehicle's approach alternatives skip the usable-area test; off:
they must pass it as primaries do.

approach_alternative_walk.description:
A vehicle's approach search tries the eight alternative cells in
the original's order (0, −1), (1, −2), …, (0, 0); off: the eight
neighbours in direction order 0 to 7.

area_damage_per_foundation_cell.description: A building takes one hit for each scanned foundation cell within the spread radius.

assaulter_reversed_kill_credit.description: An assault that clears garrison occupants records the surviving assaulter as destroyed by each removed occupant, which gets the kill credit and experience; off: each removed occupant is the victim, with destruction notifications and loss bookkeeping, and the assaulter gets ordinary kill credit and experience. The assaulter survives in both settings.

attack_decay_without_body.description: A sound entry with the attack or decay word whose samples leave no body sample makes no sound, then stays silent for the session; off: its attack and decay samples play.

auto_crush_computer_only.description:
The crushers of player houses never make the crush response: the auto-crush flag and the
player-auto-crush rule have no effect.

barrel_probe_top_left_only.description: An exploding building probes for barrels from its top-left cell only.

berserk_action_cursor.description: A berserk infantry or vehicle representative shows the cursor of its resolved action; off: the ordinary arrow (presentation only, the action and orders are unchanged).

berserk_carrier_tote.description: A berserk carrier aircraft can still get tote and its move order; off: it gets no order, like every berserk object.

berserk_zero_duration.description: A berserk hit whose duration T is 0 or less still makes the target drop its target and queue *hunt*, berserk until its next update; off: such a hit has no effect on the target (`glasnost_sim::psychic::enter`).

blackout_one_short.description: A blackout of length d counts as 0 output in at most d − 1 house updates.

blocked_arrow_events.description: View-arrow presses and releases made during an order block are discarded; off: they are accepted (unit orders stay blocked).

bouncing_anim_deck_impact_layer.description: An impact landing on a high-bridge deck hits the objects under the deck in that cell; off: a landing at deck height on a high-bridge cell hits the deck layer, every other impact landing the ground layer.

bouncing_anim_deep_landing.description: A move that ends 100 leptons or more below the ground height is not put back on the ground, so the landing point and what is made there lie below it; off: every ground landing is put at the ground height and claim 7 counts a height of 0.

bouncing_anim_expiry_needs_animation.description: A bouncing animation's end deals claim 8's area damage and light flash only when its type names an expiry animation; off: also when its damage amount is not 0.

bouncing_anim_impact_hits_walk.description: The impact hits go through the cell's listing as it changes; off: through the objects listed when the hits begin.

bouncing_anim_rebound_faults.description: A deck contact rebounds off the ground cell's slope under the deck, and the north-west cliff turn gives (c e, e u_x, e u_y); off: a deck contact rebounds by the flat rule and the north-west case turns across the second axis.

bouncing_anim_water_impact_hits.description: An impact landing on water makes its bounce animation and hits before the splash; off: one on water and not at deck height makes no bounce animation and no hits.

bridge_cursor_unrelated_link.description: The repair cursor offers repair at an enabled first nearby link that has neither endpoint at the traversal cell; off: such links are skipped and the first link with that endpoint decides, none giving no cursor.

bridge_event_band_short.description: The last cell along a band is skipped and a one-cell band raises nothing; off: the band is processed to its last cell.

bridge_family_by_block.description: The bridge family comes from the 5 x 5 block while the high-bridge search reaches 3 cells; off: from the cell claim 16's table finds.

bridge_span_cap.description: A span whose far piece is 30 or more cell steps away is never checked nor repaired; off: no limit.

build_step_period_cap.description: The step period never exceeds 255 ticks.

building_ammo_fast_rearm.description: A building holding more than 1 round rearms in 1 tick after a shot, over every other kind of delay.

building_cell_attack_no_weapon.description: A building with no weapon in its first slot gets attack over a cell whose generic result is attack (row BC3); off: nothing.

building_fire_point_shift_fixed.description: A building's turret displacement does not turn with its aim.

building_pitch_term.description: A straight shot at a building pitches by the building's art height term.

building_removal_second_round.description:
A building awaiting removal takes a second round of survivors and
smudge steps when it is removed; off: no second round.

building_sensor_ring_owner_only.description: Allied sensor units stop a building cloaking and a sensors ability does not; off: only non-allied sensors, by flag or ability.

building_sight_top_left.description: A building's sight, area reveal and gap field are centred on its top-left foundation cell.

building_smudge_discarded_draws.description: A destroyed building takes up to two ranged draws whose results are not used.

building_wrap_normalisation.description: A building body range's speed normalisation follows two rules: an immediate entry needs the art's normalised mark and excludes construction; a deferred entry and every wrap ignore the mark and cover construction and idle only.

bunker_clear_chosen_only.description: The clearing and waiting rows of a tank bunker's entry look only at the single chosen object of each foundation cell (F5), so when the entering vehicle is that object a second object in the cell is neither asked to scatter nor waited for; off: every candidate other than the entering vehicle on each foundation cell gets the scatter request, and the waiting row waits until none is left.

bunker_clear_far_point.description: A tank bunker's clearing and waiting rows choose each foundation cell's object by its distance from a point 896 leptons from the cell's top corner along each map axis, outside the cell, so the object nearest the cell's bottom corner is chosen; off: the distance is measured from the cell's centre (128 leptons per axis), with the same table root and tie rule.

cash_cycle_lapse.description: An income cycle that falls while the building is being erased is lost with all later cycles until the next ownership change; off: the building's first turn at or after that tick has the cycle, and cycles continue from there. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

cash_cycle_one_short.description: A tech building's income cycle comes when one tick of its countdown is left, so the period is D − 1 ticks; off: when the full D ticks have passed, so the period is D. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

cell_layer_split_on_uneven_deck.description: On a deck over uneven ground, objects come from the deck layer and the record from the ground layer.

charge_needs_type_flag.description: Only the type's explosive-charges flag plants a charge on arrival, and the veterancy explosive-charges ability plants nothing; off: the veterancy ability also plants, as the type flag does.

cheer_memory_spans_session.description: The last accepted cheer tick carries over between games of a session.

chop_rounding.description: Every floating-point result rounds toward zero (the original's program-wide mode); off: round to nearest, ties to even.

chrono_flash_keeps_order_block.description: A chrono flash restores the order block in force when it started, so a block from game start or an earlier run outlasts it.

cleanup_skips_next_house.description: The unused-house cleanup keeps the house after a removed one.

click_area_skips_kind_test.description:
A route-mode press inside a point's click area is not tested for
kind, so a selected aircraft or building can join a point (the
original). Off: every route-mode battlefield press with objects
selected meets the kind test first.

cliff_back_case_sets.description: Behind a cliff, row 1 of claim 5 becomes rock whatever its land type.

cloak_field_building_interrupt.description: A growing or shrinking cloak field stops its update after an own building's newly changed centre cell; off: each circle is applied in full.

cloak_field_overlap_loss.description: Overlapping cloak fields lose cells as in the original; off: a cell stays while any powered generator of the house covers it.

cloak_flag_ground_mobile_only.description: The type's cloak flag is ignored for aircraft and buildings; off: they can cloak by themselves.

cloak_generator_zero_radius_shutdown.description: An accepted manual power-off of a cloak generator makes shrinking pending even at radius 0, a current radius of 0 becoming the type radius first (no coverage is added); off: shrinking is requested only at a positive current radius, as for an ordinary loss of operation.

cloak_zero_speed_stall.description: With a cloaking speed of 0 cloaking advances a stage per tick and uncloaking never advances; off: fixed.

coarse_limit_records_cost.description: A coarse route found at the pending limit still sets the sector's cost.

collapsed_pier_span_search.description: A span check passes over collapsed piers at both ends, so a pier collapse can join two spans into one checked extent; off: a collapsed pier stays eligible as a start or far piece.

corridor_free_part_ignores_height.description: The free part judges each cell at its own height level, not by the height rule.

corridor_free_part_unusable_cells.description: Cells of an unusable category belong to the free part.

corridor_retry_no_fallback.description:
A failed new coarse search after a corridor retry fails the path
computation, with no further cell search.

corridor_split_probe.description: Whether the progress sector is split is decided at the probe cell.

country_index_wraps.description: Country lists cannot tell apart countries whose indices are equal modulo 32.

cow_idle.description: The hard-coded cow type's idle action can scatter it.

crash_death_weapon_twice.description: An exploding aircraft fires its death weapon at death and again at the crash.

crash_drops_planted_bomb.description: A bomb planted on a pad-bound aircraft that crashes at S-0501 claim 46's fall-back without going off during the fall is removed at impact with no detonation, animation or damage; off: at impact, before the death weapon, the bomb goes off by S-0519 claim 5 at the aircraft's position, with its attacker and attacking house.

crate_bonus_reaches_limbo.description: Armour, firepower and speed crates also boost objects off the map whose last recorded position lies inside the crate area; off: only objects on the map are affected, as for cloak and veteran.

crate_count_humans_only.description: Only human participants count for the initial crate count.

crate_harvester_list_prefix.description: The unit crate's harvester rule tests only the first two entries of the refinery list and of the harvester list; off: every entry of both lists is tested.

crate_phantom_place.description: A selected crate cell whose overlay a terrain object prevents still occupies its crate place, with its lifetime draw, until expiry; off: the failed overlay placement takes no place or lifetime draw. Unreachable in our engine: no terrain object blocks an overlay on a cell the placement search accepted, so both settings act alike.

crate_unit_fallback_unit_argument.description: A unit crate that cannot place its unit gives money with the unit power-up's argument as the base b; off: with the money power-up's argument, as a money crate would.

crush_slowdown_counts_self.description: The driving vehicle counts itself as a vehicle in the cell it drives into.

crush_slowdown_first_overlay.description: Ship and walking-vehicle crush slowdown is set by the overlay type of registration index 0.

crush_slowdown_ground_layer.description: The crush slowdown looks at the ground layer whichever layer the vehicle is in.

crush_slowdown_persists.description: The crush-slowdown state ends only when the vehicle next crushes an overlay.

crushable_overlay_stays.description: A crushed crushable overlay that is not a wall stays in its cell.

crusher_entry_ground_layer.description: Row VR2 reads the first vehicle of the ground layer even when the deck layer counts.

crusher_overlay_index0_clear.description: A crusher reads obstacle outcomes as clear in cells whose overlay has registration index 0.

cull_experience_path.description: A cull's experience has no rank multiplier, no alliance test and no unscored test, and divides by the parasite's cost for its own house; off: the cull is a destruction credited to the parasite under S-0311 claims 7 to 10.

curtain_nullifies_small_detonation.description: A small detonation that finds a curtain-protected object hits only protected objects.

curtain_organic_vehicle_defended.description: The curtain's hit on an organic vehicle or aircraft does not ignore defences and credits nobody; off: it ignores defences and credits the launching house.

damaging_entry_cursor_retained.description: Hovering an engineer over a building above its capture threshold retains the preceding cursor; off: it uses the capture cursor of table C.

deadlock_no_yield.description:
No unit of a deadlock gives way (the original). Off (our design, C7
part 5): in a deadlock of stalled units (`path_through_stalled_blockers`
off) with no way round, the units near it heading against the one
with the lowest object id give way: each goes to the nearest free cell
off the other side's way, waits there until the other side has
arrived or passed it (or for a longest wait) and then resumes its
order. A deadlock with a way round keeps C7 part 4's detour.

death_weapon_unplaced_projectile.description: The death weapon's projectile tests use its unplaced default position.

deck_side_step_ground_level.description: A step from a bridge deck is judged by the ground level under the deck, so a side step of 1 level lands on ground 3 or 5 levels below; off: such a step onto a cell that is not a bridge cell is refused.

default_sound_priority_ignored.description: The sound data's game-wide default priority is read and never applied: an entry without its own priority is normal; off: it is the default for entries without their own priority.

defeat_cancellation_skip.description: Immediate deletions by one destruction hit of a defeat or surrender skip later objects.

defeat_during_end_delay.description: A house defeated during the end delay loses (the person-played house's win turns into a loss and restarts the delay).

defeat_reveal_keeps_pending.description: The defeat reveal leaves the defeated house's pending re-cover marks in place.

defeated_enemy_house_kept.description: A defeated enemy house stays the enemy house until an anger value next changes.

defence_line_partial_factory_check.description: The factory check after a building-factory event covers only the ordinary-building line.

delay_kill_credited_again.description: Every hit that changes the health of a building in a delayed-kill countdown credits its destruction again.

delay_kill_whole_cell_spread.description: The delayed-kill countdown divides by the spread's whole cells, so a spread below one cell gives 0.

delete_selects_after_release.description:
A point delete applied after the route-mode key's release selects
the next point, which the delete key then deletes unseen (the
original). Off: a point delete applied while the key is not held
selects no point.

deploy_command_silent.description: The deploy command's game-wide sound is never read, so the command is silent; off: it is read and played.

deploy_makes_control_permanent.description: A controlled vehicle that deploys into a building leaves its controller's list silently and the owner change becomes permanent; off: the new object inherits the control link, the original owner and the list place, and is released as the old object would have been (`glasnost_sim::mind::converted`).

deploy_refuses_own_walls.description: A deploying vehicle cannot deploy onto its own house's wall.

deploy_sound_repeats.description: Each deploy or undeploy processing requests the type's deploy or undeploy sound, so landing and transitions repeat the request every processing; off: the deploy sound is requested once, at the first step that starts landing, a transition or an immediate deploy, and the undeploy sound once when an undeploy step starts. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

deploy_stall_zero_delay.description: With a presentation stage delay of 0 no stages advance, so a deploy with E > 1 or an undeploy with E > 2 never completes; off: any zero-delay transition completes at the next processing. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

deploy_to_fire_repacks.description: A deployed deploy-to-fire vehicle with the in-place deploy flag queues *unload* again instead of firing, so it cycles between deploying and undeploying and never fires; off: a deployed deploy-to-fire vehicle fires normally, and only a mobile one queues *unload*. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

deploy_transition_discards_orders.description: A behaviour queued during deploying or undeploying is replaced by *guard* at completion; off: completion starts the pending behaviour, or *guard* if none is pending. Not implemented yet (wave 2).

depot_loss_leaves_sleep.description: After its depot is destroyed, a contacted vehicle after its movement arrival in the docking-point cell, docked or not, keeps its behaviour: one in sleep stays asleep and neither fires nor reacts until ordered, one in guard stays in guard; off: destruction gives such contacts the sale's run-away notice and one in sleep switches to guard.

depot_loss_strands_hover.description: A hovering vehicle whose depot is destroyed after it became settled, or sold with no destination ending its being settled before the depot's removal (one it receives while still above the ground does not), stays settled and switched off and, once down on the ground, never moves again; off: losing contact with a depot ends its being settled, so it is switched on again and rises.

depot_remote_repair.description: A docked vehicle ordered away keeps receiving paid repair steps wherever it stands still; off: a move or attack order ends its contact as for an approaching vehicle, so steps happen only at the depot.

destroyed_rocket_still_detonates.description: A rocket missile destroyed in flight still detonates (claim 20).

destruction_smudge_zero_anchor.description:
A destruction smudge's anchor cell with both coordinates 0 receives
no smudge and the smudge choice takes no draw; off: that anchor takes
the ordinary fit, candidate and choice rules, map legality included.

detonate_in_planter_name.description: A detonate order is issued in the planter's house's name.

detour_after_tunnel_position.description:
After a tunnel step, the detour pass starts afresh at the cell north
of the tunnel entrance.

detour_mirrored_reference.description:
From the third leg of the detour pass on, the reference distance is
taken to the step's end cell mirrored through the leg's first cell.

disarm_bomb_needs_weapon.description: Disarm bomb gives its attack order only to an actor able to fire; off: it needs only that the actor is movable.

disc_laser_no_house.description: A disc laser's detonation names the firer as attacker but no attacking house; off: the attacking house is the firer's owner, as for a projectile's detonation.

disc_laser_unlimited_range.description: A disc laser whose weapon has the unlimited range compares its re-check distance with that negative value as it is, so it is cancelled at its first step and never deals damage; off: unlimited range never cancels a disc laser on distance.

dock_bound_aircraft_ignores_limit.description: A dock-bound aircraft type is tested at queue time by the dock test only.

docked_hover_water_loss.description: A hovering vehicle docked at a naval yard on water whose switch-off spin ends less than 104 leptons above the water is lost, as at any other spin end over water; off: a spin end that comes while it has contact with a depot or is settled at a depot (by its arrival, a settling processing, or a disabling in contact or in a depot's cell) makes no water test, and a later spin end after its contact has ended and it is not settled at a depot is tested as usual, as is that of a hovering vehicle disabled away from any depot.

dominator_damage_storm_house.description: A dominator strike's area damage names the current storm owner as attacking house, sampled before the storm's own update; off: the dominating house.

dominator_ground_layer_only.description: A dominator sweep visits only the ground layer of each swept cell, so an object on a bridge deck is never reached; off: the deck layer of a swept cell is visited after its ground layer, in the same way.

dominator_marks_own_objects.description: A dominator strike makes the dominating house's own objects permanently controlled with a ring; off: they are left alone.

dominator_rate_thousandths.description: The map's dominator fade rate is stored in thousandths and used as ticks (a map value of 1 means 1000 ticks); off: the map value is a number of ticks, truncated as the nuke rate is.

dominator_sweep_from_nearest.description: A dominator sweep examines, in each swept cell, only the start object (the nearest to the cell's top corner, S-0207 F8) and the objects listed after it, up to the first listing that is no infantry, vehicle, aircraft or building; off: every listed infantry, vehicle and aircraft of the layer is examined, in listing order.

dominator_takes_dying.description: A dominator sweep takes over an examined object that is still in play while dying; off: a dying object is not examined.

done_aircraft_click_cancels.description: A left click on a done aircraft with every dock taken cancels it.

double_start_resolution.description: Start positions are resolved twice, from three start lists, the assignment against the early phase's list 2; off: one list after the terrain is loaded.

drain_orders_bypass_normal_checks.description: Drain-mode orders change the drain state without testing grant, readiness, the clock or suspension, restart the clock even when suspended, and do not consume a one-time record; off: they need a granted record that is not suspended, and a one-time record is consumed on launch.

drain_position_check_vehicles_only.description: Only a drainer that is a vehicle performs the position check, so an infantry or aircraft drainer keeps its link after it moves away until claim 11 or 13 ends it; off: every drainer performs it.

drain_relink_strands_previous.description: A drain attempt that forms a link while the drainer is still linked to another building does not end the first link, which stays drained (blackout, refused firing, sale refusal, payouts) until the drainer is removed; off: forming a new link first ends the old one with all of claim 14's effects.

drive_brake_floor_raises.description: Within the slowdown distance the braking floor raises a slower vehicle to the floor.

drive_curve_chaining_passive_only.description: Only passive vehicles chain two-cell curves.

drive_duplicate_scatter_request.description: A blocked driving vehicle can send its scatter request to the same cell layer twice in one tick; off: only the earliest.

drive_giveup_ignores_contact.description: A driving vehicle's give-up test at a step check ignores contact.

drive_leftover_kept_at_rest.description: A vehicle that comes to rest keeps its leftover progress budget for its next move; off: the budget is cleared at rest.

drive_nearest_from_top_corner.description: The nearest object of the look at a new path's first cell is measured from the cell's top corner; off: from its centre.

drive_subpoint_compounding.description: The step towards the next track point is taken from the current, possibly interpolated, position.

drive_track_end_cap.description: A tick finishes at most one track if it began without one, two if it began on one.

dying_victim_holds_slot.description: A dying victim holds its controller slot for as long as it still exists as the same object (a sinking ship, a building awaiting delayed destruction); off: a victim leaves its controller's list at its killing hit (`glasnost_sim::mind::killed`).

early_phase_stale_country_data.description: The early phase judges passivity by the base rules' country data only; off: by this game's full rules layering.

elevation_deck_cell_level.description: Elevation levels add 4 for every cell marked as carrying a bridge deck.

elite_occupant_skips_occupy_weapon.description: An elite occupant without an elite occupying weapon fires its own primary.

empty_box_release_click.description: An unmodified band box with no live screen candidate falls through to a click at its release pixel; off: it clears the selection.

engineer_lost_on_uncapturable.description: An engineer entering a building that is neither arrival-friendly nor capturable is used up and changes nothing; off: the entry is refused as in claim 4 and the engineer stays.

engineer_repairs_during_sale.description: An engineer reaching a damaged arrival-friendly building during its sale repairs it and is used up; off: sale-time entry is refused as in claim 4, regardless of health.

enter_nearest_survives_absorption.description: A unit of the neutral or special house that took the enter-nearest instruction through the bio-reactor fate keeps it when it goes in and when it is let out, so a released passenger walks straight back in; off: going in clears the instruction.

entered_by_country_only.description: The entered-by value is read only as a country index, so player-position values never match; off: it is resolved like an action's house value.

erasure_distance_leader_only.description: Only a leading erasing attacker inside an open-topped transport is checked against the warp distance, not joiners; off: the distance limit applies to every attached open-topped passenger.

erasure_double_experience.description: A trainable erasing leader gets F5's direct experience gain on top of ordinary kill credit, which may go elsewhere; off: only ordinary S-0311 credit remains.

erasure_refused_hit_side_effects.description: A delivered erasing hit clears the target's spawner slots and frees the units it mind-controls even when the new lock is refused; off: a refused lock does not clear spawners or free controlled units (the firer's previous beam still lets go).

erasure_release_switches_on.description: When the last erasing attacker lets go before completion, the building is switched on regardless of its state before the lock; off: release restores its switch state from before the first lock.

event_latch_aliasing.description: Event positions 33 and later share the latch of the position 32 lower, including clearing by aliased timer positions; off: every position has its own latch.

exact_trigger_type_names.description: The type name of the type-exists and type-does-not-exist events is matched case-sensitively, with no no-type markers; off: S-0003 claim 14's case-insensitive matching and markers.

expected_damage_firer_armour.description: The expected damage divides by the armour factor for the firer's kind and the firer's armour multiplier.

experience_cost_victim_house.description: The recipient's actual cost is computed for the destroyed object's house.

factory_apron_short_list.description:
A ground factory whose exit list has fewer than eleven entries takes
the original's special apron pairs; off: the list's last pair, (0, 0)
for an empty list.

factory_fixed_hover_exit.description:
A released vehicle that neither drives nor drives temporarily heads
for the fixed cell (x₀ + 4, y₀ + 1); off: the exit apron.

factory_unload_waits_ready_mark.description:
A factory's release queues *unload* and its closing queues *guard*,
each starting only at a per-tick start that finds the ready mark
set; off: queueing either also sets the ready mark.

failed_packup_keeps_vehicle.description: The vehicle of a failed pack-up remains.

fire_frame_by_stance.description: The fire frame is chosen by stance and weapon, not by the playing kind.

fire_particle_no_house.description: A kill by a fire particle has no attacking house, though its system may have one; off: the hit's attacking house is the system's owner house, as for gas (`glasnost_sim::particles`).

fire_reveal_expires.description: The reveal on fire is a plain reveal that the next re-cover sweep undoes.

first_comment_only.description: Only the type's first idle comment sound is used.

flame_sweep_facing.description: The flame sweep's facing constants are 16383 and 65534; off: 16384 and 65536 (`glasnost_sim::particles::flame_sweep`).

flatten_straight_run_v.description: Some straight runs open a V that flattening replaces.

flatten_threat_start_cell.description: Flattening reads the threat value at the new steps' first cell.

flying_candidates_unfiltered.description: A tracked flying object is not left out for being the source object or a listed harvester.

flying_listed_double_hit.description: An object found by both the flying-object search and a scanned cell of a detonation keeps both entries and can take two hits, the flying entry first; off: it keeps only its flying entry.

flying_search_sectors.description: The flying-object search reads only the sectors of F7 and can miss a flying object in range.

flying_sensor_disc_stationary.description: Ordinary flying movement never relocates a mobile sensor's disc, even on landing; off: each horizontal cell-boundary crossing in flight relocates it to the new cell (coverage only, no adjacency uncloak).

follow_index_by_place.description: The placed vehicle numbered i takes the follow value numbered i, not its own entry's; off: each vehicle takes its own entry's value.

forced_start_player_hold.description: A forced start with no switched-on factory starts on a player hold when the house can pay P ÷ 54.

foundation_exit_lists.description: The infantry exit search uses each foundation's fixed exit list, gaps and repeats included.

fraidycat_ammo_panic_ignores_fearless.description: A fraidycat that fires its last round panics even when fearless.

fraidycat_fear_ignores_fearless.description: A fearless fraidycat still gets its fear set by a known attacker.

full_cell_no_regrowth.description: Harvesting a full cell takes it out of growth until a rebuilding.

full_volume_16383.description: A sound entry's volume of 100 % gives level 16383; off: 16384.

gap_end_keeps_cover.description: When a hostile gap field stops, its cells stay unexplored until a sight reaches them.

gap_radius_wrap.description: A gap radius is read reduced into −128 … 127.

garrison_capacity_equality.description: Garrison entry is refused only when the occupant count equals the capacity, so a negative capacity admits occupants indefinitely; off: entry requires an occupant count below the capacity, so a non-positive capacity admits none.

garrison_exit_skips_corner.description: A garrison's exit search never tries the corner cell (x₀ − 1, y₀ − 1); off: the corner is tried last.

garrison_negative_level_exit.description: A garrison's exit candidate at terrain level −6 or lower qualifies without the later entry tests; off: it gets the ordinary terrain, usable-area and occupancy tests.

garrison_no_exit_removes.description: An eviction without inside fallback and with no qualifying exit cell removes every occupant; off: the eviction does nothing and the occupants stay inside.

garrison_range_drops_air_bonus.description: A garrisoned building's range replaces the weapon range and its air bonus.

gate_reverse_snaps.description: A gate door that reverses from closing to opening is at rest open at the gate's next update; off: the reopening takes as long as the closing had run.

gate_tower_fixed_cells.description: A gate's or wall tower's placement and departure recompute the wall bits of fixed cells around its top-left foundation cell only; off: also every wall beside any of its foundation cells.

gattling_air_test_slot_one.description: A gattling type's anti-air test reads the weapon in slot 1.

gattling_zero_spin_down_empties.description: A spin-down update whose amount d × m is 0 sets the spin value to 0 at once; off: an amount of 0 leaves the value unchanged (`glasnost_sim::gattling::spin_down`).

grinder_no_arrival_recheck.description: A recycling building tests nothing about itself or its owner when an entrant arrives, so a building being sold, switched off or now owned by a house that does not count the entrant's house as allied still consumes the entrant and pays its owner; off: at consumption the building gives claim 2's docking answer to every entrant, infantry included, without the link-place row, and a refused entrant is not consumed, its destination is cleared and it falls back to rest.

ground_detonation_misses_aircraft.description: Tracked flying objects are considered only by a detonation above the terrain at the centre of its cell.

group_center_keeps_extra_selection.description:
*Centre group* keeps the rest of the selection, objects outside the
group included, when the first selected object is in the group, and
centres on all of them (the original). Off: it replaces the
selection with the group's members first, as *select group* does.

group_kept_on_owner_change.description:
A control-group number stays with the object through an owner
change (the original). Off: a group belongs to the house that made
it, and an object counts as a member only while that house owns it.

group_spread_no_detour.description: No further search follows a spoiled group-destination look: the member gets its fallback cell (the original). Off (our design, C7 part 4): a member whose look gives no cell of its own gets the nearest open cell round the common cell, in the common cell's reach region and given to no other member.

harvest_cell_shared.description:
A harvester's ring search accepts an ore cell that another unit of
its house is already heading for (the original). Off (our design, C7
part 5): such a cell is not acceptable, so harvesters sent to one
field each take a cell of their own.

harvester_failed_step_off_origin.description:
An idle harvester whose step-off search finds no cell gets the
off-map destination cell (0, 0); off: its destination is cleared.

heal_reveals_cloaked.description: Healing or a zero-damage hit uncloaks; off: only hits that lower health.

height_block_cell.description: The height block tests the displaced cell and the step directions of table T2.

hidden_point_refuses_click.description:
A route-mode press that takes no highlighted point is tested against
the earliest-made point of any house whose click area holds the
cursor, drawn or not, so a point the player cannot see can refuse
the press (the original). Off: only points drawn for the player are
tested, and a point not drawn plays no part in a press.

hijack_truce_harvester_check.description: The harvester-truce exception of row I15 never applies.

hover_brake_undershoot.description: A braking step is floored at 0 and can cross below a positive goal; off: floored at the goal.

hover_deployed_keeps_moving.description: A hover that becomes deployed in place while it still holds movement finishes that movement deployed and then stands; off: becoming deployed drops *D* and the stored path, and the hover finishes only the leg to its current heading point.

hover_elevated_heading_point.description: A next heading point gains 416 leptons whenever the vehicle is 312 or more above its terrain, bridge or not; off: a high-bridge cell is needed too.

hover_flag_clear_height_only.description: Clearing a vehicle-present flag picks the deck by the point's height alone, while setting also needs a high bridge; off: clearing needs the high bridge too.

hover_idle_arrival_reservation.description: Clearing the last heading point at an arrival with no destination and no choice keeps its old reservation; off: that reservation is released and the actual position is marked instead.

hover_landing_request_stands.description: A landing-first in-place hover whose first deploy step found it above the ground keeps its landing request while it hovers, so it never deploys and *unload* stays current; off: a hover no longer moving treats a standing landing request as met, and its next deploy step deploys it by S-0517 claim 4's height-0 rows.

hover_needs_nonzero_start.description: The hover substitution needs a hover entry starting at a frame other than 0.

hover_stalled_start_reset.description: A zero step length while heading exactly at the heading point sets the throttle and fraction to 1 at once; off: no reset.

hunt_distance_in_leptons.description: The map-wide search measures ground-layer distance in leptons.

hunt_ground_layer_only.description: The map-wide search considers only ground-layer objects besides aircraft.

hunt_ignores_distributed_fire.description: A distributed-fire searcher picks nothing in a map-wide search.

infantry_animation_occupancy.description: An infantry-making animation marks its position taken and sets the cell's infantry house in every update, and frees the position at its end whatever holds it; off: it holds the position only while no other unit does, leaves the infantry house alone while other infantry stands there and frees only its own mark.

infantry_facing_sector_skew.description: Infantry facing groups are skewed 1024 facing units counter-clockwise.

infantry_fixed_turn_rate.description: Infantry bodies turn at the fixed rate 127.

infantry_limit_exception_exact.description: The infantry in-production exception of the build limit applies only at exactly L owned.

infiltration_single_effect.description: An infiltrated building type that matches several effect rows gives only the first; off: every matching row applies in table order, and E3 requires only tech-lab-list membership.

initial_ammo_above_capacity.description:
An explicit initial ammunition above a nonnegative maximum is used as
it stands; off: capped at the maximum.

jumpjet_bridge_early_cruise_height.description: An own-cell early cruise keeps the height above the surface r as its target even when the take-off threshold used the smaller bridge-adjusted h, so it can climb again above the deck; off: it keeps h at that transition.

jumpjet_falling_touchdown_tracked.description: A jumpjet touching down in the bridge or parachute falling state, or no longer alive or in play, stays a tracked flying object; off: every touchdown ends its registration.

jumpjet_lookahead_bridge.description: The look-ahead adds the bridge height of the cell ahead to the jumpjet's own cell's clearance, not to the ahead cell's; off: each cell's bridge height is added to that cell's clearance.

jumpjet_no_cell_self_destruct.description: A jumpjet that cannot land and finds no cell nearby destroys itself; off: it clears its movement point and commitment and, at a height above the surface of 1 lepton or more, re-enters *hovering* over its current cell, neither descending nor flying on, while at 0 or less it stays put and becomes *grounded*, even from *ascending* (every seized set-down unit hovering in this outcome, by any route, then follows S-0607 claims 9 and 20).

jumpjet_step_truncation.description: A straight-line step uses F5's shifted angle, table trigonometry and separate coordinate truncation, so southward and westward steps drift one lepton across the line of travel; off: the displacement is the speed times the double-precision sine and cosine of the facing, rounded half away from zero.

jumpjet_turn_slowdown_one_sided.description: The cruise bands' remaining-turn test uses the clockwise difference only, so even a small anticlockwise turn takes the band's slower speed; off: it uses the smaller of the clockwise and anticlockwise differences.

landing_own_cell_no_result.description: When the own-cell landing search near a close building finds no cell, the landing destination becomes the placeholder at map cell (0, 0), which the aircraft discards at the end of its update and is given again, possibly heading for that map corner; off: the failed search counts as no successful building choice and the other-object fallback follows, with the chosen building counted like any other own-house object, and finally the aircraft's own cell.

last_bale_lost.description: The last bale taken from a cell yields nothing.

launch_spacing_from_spawner_type.description: The 9-tick launch spacing is chosen by the missile-spawn flag of the spawner's own type, not of the spawned type; off: the spawned type's flag decides.

lift_deck_impact_reads_ground.description: When a dropped unit's fall ends on a bridge deck, the objects listed in the ground layer under the bridge decide what lies underneath, not those on the deck; off: the layer the unit landed in decides.

lift_drop_erases_cell_tail.description: When the first other object under a dropped unit is an infantry unit, every object after it in the cell's list is also removed, whatever its kind, the dropped unit included when it is listed after the infantry; off: only infantry units in the cell are removed, and the dropped unit never is.

lift_impact_double_credit.description: The impact credit of a dropped unit's fall is given whether or not one of the two impact detonations has already killed it, so such a unit is credited twice: once to the detonation's source and once more to the dropper (else the dropper house), in the kill and loss tallies, the score and the experience; off: the impact credit is skipped for a unit a detonation has already killed.

lift_impact_removes_survivor.description: A dropped unit that ends its fall in *crashed* leaves play after the two impact detonations even when they did not kill it; off: a unit that survives both detonations stays in play, is set down and gets its own locomotor back.

lift_standin_stays_seized.description: A unit seized with the driving, walking, ship or teleporting stand-in locomotor is never restored, and one seized with the drop-pod stand-in gets its own locomotor back but stays seized, so either way it ignores destinations and cannot fire until it leaves play; off: claim 20's restoration applies to every stand-in, with that stand-in's own moving test, and clears the seized state.

lift_standin_unmarked_cell.description: A unit seized with the driving, walking or ship stand-in locomotor gives up the vehicle-present mark of its cell at the seize and holds none until its stand-in's own movement starts a step into a neighbouring cell, so one that never moves stands unmarked for good; its listed presence still decides vehicle entry outcomes, but rules that read only the occupancy record, such as the nearby-cell search, see its cell as free; off: it keeps the vehicle-present mark of its own cell at the seize, as a vehicle at rest does (the teleporting stand-in is unchanged).

low_bridge_wrong_axis_recheck.description: A low piece of the other axis along the line is re-evaluated with this line's table; off: not re-evaluated.

low_strip_regress.description: Re-evaluation can turn a damaged strip back to an intact look; off: never from damaged to intact.

mind_control_owner_change_keeps_victims.description: A controller that changes owner keeps its victims, which keep their owner and original owners and stay on its list; off: an owner change releases all victims first, as claim 10 does (`glasnost_sim::mind::owner_changed`).

mind_controlled_passengers_cell_choice.description: Passengers of a mind-controlled open-topped transport take the cell's last object only.

mirage_adjacent_check_cadence.description: The neighbouring-infantry check runs on 7 ticks of 8; off: only on multiples of 8.

missile_turn_wrap.description: The steering turn step uses only the residue mod 256 and is a signed 16-bit value.

missile_without_launcher_consumes_charge.description: A missile superweapon whose house cannot start a launch sequence consumes its charge and launches nothing; off: the order is refused and the record stays ready.

missing_sample_silences_entry.description: One sample missing from the audio archive silences the whole sound entry; off: the missing sample is left out of the list and the rest play.

mobile_sensor_removal_centre.description: A mobile sensor leaving play removes its disc around its current cell; off: around the cell where it was last added.

moment_reason_attack_cursor.description: The attack rule's part (e) takes the firing check's answer, so a reason of the moment that ranks above a target test hides it: while the rearm countdown runs, out of ammunition, cloaked, or with an early rearming of rank 4 (phasing in among them) the attack is offered over a target only those tests refuse; off: part (e) asks only whether a reason that gives illegal holds, at any rank, passing over every reason of the moment.

multiple_factory_counts_all.description: Every factory building of the kind counts for the several-factories factor, also those that cannot make the item.

mutation_test_ground_record.description: The conversion test's position choice reads the cell's ground record even for a victim on a high-bridge deck; off: a victim on a deck is tested against the deck record.

named_deploy_area_fire.description: The deploy area-fire rule singles out one infantry type by name.

narrow_map_partial_pass.description: On a map of width 1 the cell pass visits part of the map.

near_full_health_rounds_up.description: A pre-placed object whose starting health comes out above its strength less 3 starts at full strength; off: it keeps the computed value.

nearby_centre_twice.description: The nearby-cell search examines its centre twice.

negative_elevation_cap.description:
A negative elevation bonus cap applies as it is, even at no height
difference; off: the cap is max(0, cap) in the elevation bonus.

negative_level_floor_raised.description: The level base below level 0 is one lepton higher.

negative_range_fields.description:
Negative weapon range, minimum range and air range bonus fields are
used as they are; off: max(0, value), the unlimited −512 kept.

negative_self_heal_counts.description: Negative self-heal counts are added without a floor.

negative_threat_field.description: A negative threat field takes its amount away from the threat records.

nominal_survivor_count.description: A nominal survivor is not added to the infantry count but is taken off when it leaves.

non_unloading_refinery_accepts.description: A dock-type building without the dock-unload flag still accepts refinery contact, leaving the harvester in enter without unloading; off: such buildings are excluded from both refinery choices and refuse refinery contact.

none_owner_is_first_country.description: A trigger owner written as <none> gives the first country of the country list; off: <none> names no owner country.

nuke_silo_first_type_only.description: Only the first silo type in type-list order that names the superweapon can launch it; off: every such silo type is considered, in type-list order.

observer_position_handoff.description: An observer's drawn position is handed to the next player needing one.

occupancy_house_side_positions_only.description: The infantry house clears when no side position stays taken.

occupancy_house_stale.description: The infantry house stays that of the last infantry unit to mark, even after it left.

occupancy_override_hides_later_blockers.description: An overriding occupant hides blockers listed after it.

occupant_experience_next_in_turn.description: A garrison's experience goes to the occupant whose turn to fire it is.

occupant_experience_untrained.description: A garrison's firing occupant gains experience whatever its trainable flag.

offmap_cells_shared.description: Every cell that is not legal shares one explored state per house.

omnicrusher_needs_crusher.description: The omni-crusher flag alone makes no vehicle a crusher.

one_sided_building_distance.description: The building reduction applies only to the second object of a distance.

one_time_grant_keeps_stale_suspension.description: A one-time grant keeps the suspension of a record lost while suspended; off: it ends any suspension.

opposite_facing_reversal.description: The close case reverses the occupant's facing by 32767, not 32768.

origin_as_missing_target_point.description: The world origin stands for no target point in both directions.

overlay_list_position_rules.description: Radar overlay colours depend on the overlay type's position in the overlay list.

override_suspends_queued.description: An override suspends the queued behaviour when one is queued.

owned_shell_ground_pass.description: A straight or arcing projectile that has a firer is detonated only by the deck crossings of T1's first row.

ownership_gain_counts_as_kill.description: An ownership change gives the gaining house a kill on the result screen; off: only destructions add kills.

packup_release_by_guard_spot.description: A packing building releases survivors according to its guard spot and undeploy type only.

packup_sound_on_sale.description: A sold building with a pack-up sound also plays it.

pad_distance_overflow.description: The squared pad distance of F9 wraps in 32 bits, so a very distant pad can look nearer; off: exact squared distances.

pad_limit_counts_list_only.description: The pad limit's count includes only types in the pad-aircraft list; off: the asked-for type is counted too.

paradrop_fallback_point.description: An edge-cell selection without an acceptable candidate (a paradrop's arrival cell, an aircraft's retreat or spy-plane exit destination) uses the local point (1, ⌊width / 2⌋), with coordinates reversed from the north midpoint; off: (⌊width / 2⌋, 1). Implemented for the paradrop arrival cells and the aircraft edge cells of S-0501 claim 34.

paradrop_west_edge_start_row.description: A paradrop's west scan starts at local row r − 1, which is row −1 when r = 0; off: it starts at row r modulo 2·height and continues cyclically. The draw is unchanged. Implemented for the paradrop arrival cells and the aircraft edge cells of S-0501 claim 34.

parasite_carrier_loss_strands_unit.description: A parasite whose carrying projectile is removed without detonating stays off the map, unattached; off: it attempts claim 4's failed-latch return.

parasite_exit_search_host_mobility.description: A parasite's exit-cell search uses the host's locomotion class and movement zone; off: the parasite's own.

parasite_exit_tests_host_cell.description: Whether a parasite may come out at all is judged on the host's cell, not on the chosen cell; off: the chosen cell is tested.

parasite_host_loss_bridge_test.description: On host loss, the fallback neighbour's restricted land passes when the host's cell has a bridge; off: the neighbour's own bridge is tested.

parasite_host_loss_failed_choice_origin.description: On host loss, a vehicle parasite whose fallback standing-position choice fails survives at world position (128, 128, 0) leptons outside the playable map; off: it is removed silently like infantry, with the same draw count.

parasite_host_loss_suppresses_naval.description: On host loss, a suppressed naval parasite is removed silently; off: a naval parasite ignores suppression here too.

parasite_suppressed_latch_strands_unit.description: A parasite whose projectile detonates with takeover, bomb planting or electric charging selected stays off the map, unattached and inactive; off: it attempts claim 4's failed-latch return (never attaching).

paratrooper_any_animation_slow_fall.description: A falling object uses the parachute fall recurrence while any animation is attached to it; off: only while the parachute animation is attached. The parachute is the only animation our simulation attaches, so both settings behave alike.

passability_laser_fence_lost.description: Laser-fence sections leave the passability category alone.

passability_wheel_column.description: The passability category judges every class by the wheel column.

passenger_weapon_needs_secondary.description: A passenger weapon index is used only by a firer with weapons in both slots.

path_congestion_toggle.description: Congestion marks follow the parity of each cell's count.

path_no_reopen.description: A recorded search pair keeps its first cost and is never reopened.

path_refresh_keeps_old_step.description: A path recomputed as the last step begins keeps the old step and drops the new path's first.

path_search_10000_failure.description: A search that reaches the destination after exactly 10000 expansions fails.

path_through_stalled_blockers.description:
A stalled unit's re-path may lead through the cells of other stalled
units, at the moving-blocker cost (the original). Off (our design, C7
part 4): a unit stalled for the blockage delay in a deadlock (stalled
units that wait on each other's cells), or waiting on one, first looks
for a way that keeps off the cells of the deadlock's other units, and
the computation's own searches follow when there is none; a step
refused by a unit with a destination starts the blockage timer.

pending_order_limit.description: Each house's pending list holds at most 128 orders.

permadisguise_attack_cursor.description: A permanently disguised target passes the disguise rule.

permanent_grant_freezes_suspension.description: A permanent grant on a suspended record leaves it suspended for good; off: the grant also resumes it.

persistent_event_latch.description: A latchable event of a repeating tag stays satisfied after its first satisfaction (only timer-position alias clearing undoes it); off: a trigger instance's latches are cleared each time it fires.

phase_in_beam_spares_infantry.description: While it phases in, a vehicle or aircraft with a temporal beam attached has its turns cut short whether or not it is being erased, and an infantry unit only while it is being erased; off: an infantry unit with an attached beam has its turns cut short while it phases in as well.

pier_loss_notice_skips_chipped.description: A pier chipped on one side ignores a loss notice from that side; off: any pier in state 0 to 2 turns to 3.

pier_repair_partial_height.description: Repair raises only the pier column after a collapse lowered the pier's whole tile; off: the whole tile is restored.

placed_buildings_not_ever_built.description: A building put on the map by a place order does not raise its type's ever-built count.

placed_buildup_twice.description: A placed building's build-up runs once before *construction* becomes current and again after (off: the place order sets the ready mark at entry, as a deploy does).

placement_shroud_at_cursor.description: A person's placement click takes the shroud result from when the cursor entered the cell.

predependent_kind_as_list_position.description: A second stage's link names a kind whose number is a position in the superweapon type list; off: the first stage is the first type in the list of that kind.

prerequisite_names_dropped.description: An unknown or non-building prerequisite name is dropped when the list is read; off: it stays an unmet entry.

press_copy_ignores_route_state.description:
The copy a press's join gives an object can take its route past 16
points, and its loop can begin at one of the object's own points
and end before the route's last point (the original). Off: such a
join does nothing when the copy would take the route past 16
points, and the copy's loop always begins in the copy.

prism_count_survives_dropped_shot.description: A dropped or projectile-less delayed master shot keeps the support count, so the next shot gets the kept bonus on top of new supporters, with no beams for the kept part; off: the count becomes 0 whenever the delayed shot comes, fired or not.

prism_modifier_reread_scale.description: Every rules layer with a general section re-reads the support modifier with the held value as its default and multiplies the result by 100, even when the layer lacks the key; off: a layer without the key leaves the held value unchanged.

prism_support_ignores_operation.description: Supporters need not be in operation, so a switched-off, pulsed, unfinished or selling building still supports a working master; off: a building not in operation (S-0405 claim 8) is not eligible.

prism_zero_delay_double_count.description: With a prism delayed-fire field of 0, a recruited supporter stays eligible until its turn, so another master of the same house processed before then also counts it; off: a building with a pending beam is not eligible.

prone_attack_state_persists.description: A prone unit stays in the attack state and can fire again without a new firing sequence.

prone_get_up_repeated_destination.description: A prone unit asks for get-up only when its current non-empty destination is assigned again; off: every non-empty destination assignment asks.

prone_noncrawler_speedup.description: A prone unit whose type cannot crawl walks half as fast again.

protection_restart_replaces.description: Starting protection on a protected object replaces its timer and kind; off: the longer remaining time is kept, with the kind of the effect that gave it.

psychic_intent_ignores_visibility.description: Hostile-intent lines are shown for units the viewer cannot see, including cloaked, disguised and shrouded units; off: a line is shown only for a unit visible to the viewer's house (`glasnost_sim::psychic::intent_line`).

queue_limit_counts_item_twice.description: The queue-time limit test counts the item in production twice.

queued_move_sleeps.description: Queued move and attack move are processed as sleep.

radar_first_building_decides.description: Only the first qualifying radar building decides whether the house has radar.

radar_pixel_cell_shift.description: The cell a radar pixel stands for is the one F3 gives, shifted from the point colour's cell.

radiation_add_overdraw.description: Adding to a radiation field removes F5's amount r from its cells, which can exceed the field's remaining contribution by one decay step and take radiation other fields gave; off: adding removes exactly the field's own remaining contribution.

radiation_residue.description: A radiation field's end takes nothing from its cells, so a contribution its decay steps did not take stays and keeps damaging; off: at its end each cell loses what remains of that field's contribution, not below 0.

rail_missile_vanishes_with_spawner.description: Missiles on the rail vanish with no detonation when the spawner dies or changes hands; off: they are released like preparing missiles.

railgun_collinear_hits.description: A railgun candidate whose calculated line distance is not a number (exact collinearity among others) qualifies whatever the hit distance; off: the finite Euclidean distance to the beam's line (to its start for a zero-length beam), strictly below the hit distance.

raised_missile_rail_time_from_set_b.description: A set-C missile's rail time uses set B's pause and tilt times; off: set C's own times.

rally_point_shared.description:
Every unit a factory releases with a cell rally point is sent to the
rally cell itself (the original). Off (our design, C7 part 5): each
released unit is sent to a cell of its own round the rally point, the
rally cell while no other unit of the house has it.

ramp_shape_zero.description: A tile of the ramp range or of the smooth-ramp range whose slope shape is 0 becomes the tile just before the ramp range.

random_country_fixed_range.description: A random country is drawn from registration indices 0 … 9.

random_magnitude_overflow.description: The 'magnitude first' remainder keeps the negative sign of −2147483648.

random_start_asymmetric_range.description: A random start candidate's y range runs ten cells further than its x range; off: both from 11 to W + H − 10.

range_target_on_deck.description: A floor-bound target in a high-bridge cell is measured at deck height even below the bridge.

ranged_draw_half_span.description: A ranged draw whose bounds differ by exactly 2147483647 takes no value and returns the lower bound plus 2147483648, wrapped.

readiness_from_defended_damage.description: Readiness loss uses the amount after the defences and before the versus value, even when a later row stops the hit.

readiness_heal_over_max.description: A healing hit raises the ammunition of a damage-reduces-readiness type with no upper limit.

recover_keeps_pending.description: The whole-map re-cover and reveal leave pending re-cover marks in place.

recover_skips_allied_units.description: The whole-map re-cover takes in allied units' sights only at their next refresh.

redirected_shot_aim.description: An area-fire or spray shot is launched towards the firer's own target.

refinery_distance_wraps.description: The squared refinery distance is a signed 32-bit integer that wraps.

refund_at_current_price.description: A cancel refunds the item's price at the moment of the cancel less the balance owed.

refused_death_keeps_unit.description: A death request turned down because the die-1 or die-2 entry has no image frames leaves the unit in play with its current sequence; off: the resulting death kind counts as completed on the death tick. Not consulted in M3, which has no death handling (combat, M4).

refused_mutation_frees_position.description: A refused mutation victim's standing position is free from its death tick while it plays die-2, and its removal frees that position again even if a walker took it; off: the position stays taken until removal, which frees only the victim's own mark.

refused_override_retargets.description: A refused override still replaces the target and destination.

region_join_height_asymmetry.description: Cells along cell x join one region across 2 or 3 height levels.

release_order_once.description: The automatic place order of a done unit is sent once.

repair_consumes_engineer_always.description: An engineer entering a hut whose bridge needs no repair is used up; off: it is refused entry.

repair_walk_unbounded.description: The repair walk passes over other bridges' cells and can repair a different bridge; off: it stops at the first cell that is not part of a bridge.

repeat_direction_snap.description: A completed sequence's declared direction is snapped on every tick it stays current.

repeated_lightning_strike_suppressed.description: Off (the original): every lightning-strike action makes a cloud, repeated ones at one waypoint included; on: after one cloud made by the action at a waypoint, further actions at that waypoint make none.

resource_timers_carry_over.description: Resource timers carry over between games of one session.

restoration_failed_return_removes_unit.description: A starting-building restoration whose forced placement fails removes a displaced unit that cannot be put back at its original position; off: such a unit is kept and placed at a nearby cell instead.

restricted_deck_overlay_indices.description: Restricted vehicles may use a deck only above overlays of registration indices 237 and 238.

resume_restarts_step.description: A resumed line waits a full step period before its next step.

rocket_aim_at_heading_point.description: A rocket missile's aim point is fixed at the heading point of claim 14.

rocket_stalls_at_map_edge.description: A rocket missile whose path leaves the legal cells keeps the last legal position and continues its phase, speed and pitch updates; off: it detonates at the last legal position.

rocking_limit_escape.description:
An unlinked rocking angle is held at its limit only when the angle before the step was
below it, so repeated pushes can carry a body past its limit and over; off: an unlinked
angle that is not past the edge is held at its limit whenever the new angle would pass it.
Read by the client's rocking (the sim keeps no rocking state yet).

role_one_past_end.description: A role naming the first missing tileset starts at the tile count.

route_holder_count_drift.description:
The house's route-holder count is raised only by a point add to an
empty route and lowered only when a route that still holds a point
ends, so a deletion that empties a route leaves it raised and a join
that begins a route does not raise it (the original). Off: the count
is always the number of the house's route holders.

rubble_overlay_by_index.description: Rubble is the overlay type at a fixed registration index.

sale_start_no_recheck.description: The start of a sale calls for no recheck of the offer.

search_one_object_per_cell.description: A search scores only the offered object of each visited cell.

second_stage_order_unchecked.description: A second-stage superweapon order is accepted unchecked; off: it is refused unless the first stage is granted, not suspended and has an unconsumed source selection.

secondary_wins_against_air.description: The secondary is chosen against an airborne target whenever it is anti-air.

secret_lab_pick_by_position.description: Each secret lab picks its entry by position with replacement, so labs can share a type.

sensor_array_removal_radius.description: A sensor array's removal decrements over its cloak-radius disc; off: over the disc it added.

sensor_building_activation_once.description: Sensor and disguise-detector coverage is set at first placement only; off: it follows power and capture.

sensor_count_negative.description: Building removals have no floor, so a cell's sensor count can go negative; off: removal undoes exactly what was added.

set_charge_keeps_ready.description: Setting a superweapon's charge keeps an existing ready state; off: it clears readiness and the new clock completes normally.

set_facing_keeps_target.description: Setting a facing at once to its current interpolated value during a turn ends the turn at its target.

shared_control_centre_count.description: One count of active control centres per house serves every control-centre type.

shared_wave_slot.description: Sonic waves and magnetic-beam waves share one effect slot per firer.

short_game_first_three_base_units.description: Only the first three positions of the base-unit list count in the short-game test.

short_game_without_bases.description: A short game with the bases setting off is allowed (every house without a counted building fails at tick 1).

shot_distance_wrap.description: The shot-speed distance's sum of squares wraps in 32-bit arithmetic.

shrapnel_building_per_cell.description: A building takes a fragment in every visited cell where it is first-listed; off: each object takes at most one fragment from one burst's scan.

shrapnel_first_listed_only.description: Only the first-listed object of a visited cell can take a fragment, so an own or allied object listed first blocks the cell; off: the first object in listing order that passes the test.

shrapnel_hits_terrain.description: Terrain objects, which have no owning house, take fragments; off: objects without an owning house are not candidates.

shroud_negative_odd_pair.description: An odd negative height count in the shroud point test reads the cell pair one cell toward map north-west (k = (u + 3)/2); off: k = (u + 1)/2 for every odd u. No effect while the renderer's shroud_on_flat_grid is off, which the simulation never models.

shroud_point_cell_wrap.description: A cell coordinate outside 0 … 511 is read as another cell by gap fields and the shroud point test.

shroud_sound_corner_cell.description: A sound with the shroud word at cell (0, 0) is never heard; off: that cell is judged like any other.

sidebar_both_flags_rank.description:
An item with both the counts-as-aircraft and naval flags ranks 1 as
the new item and 2 as an item already in the tab; off: 1 in both.

sidebar_icon_surface_clip.description: A sidebar icon clips only at its content region's right and bottom; off: at all four edges.

sidebar_tie_newest_first.description:
A sidebar item tied with existing items on every key goes before
them (the newest first); off: after them.

sight_bonus_wrap.description: The height bonus of sight wraps into −128 … 127.

sight_centre_off_map.description: A sight whose centre is not a legal cell reveals nothing.

silo_target_of_current_owner.description: A silo launches at the target last recorded for its current owner; off: at the target recorded when it accepted the launch.

single_stage_buildup_never_completes.description: A positive-delay construction range of one stage or fewer never reports completion (off: it reports d_b ticks after the range starts).

skirmish_drops_country_owned_objects.description: In skirmish, pre-placed objects owned by a country name or a player-at-position name vanish; off: they go to the first player of that country or to the player at that position.

skirmish_drops_map_crates.description: Crate overlays placed by a map never appear in skirmish or multiplayer games; off: they are kept.

slave_kick_delay_wraps.description: The slave miner's kick delay wraps when added to the tick number.

slave_negative_capacity_stalls.description:
A slave of negative storage stays in *harvest* on its resource cell
without loading; off: it is treated as a slave of storage 0.

slave_relocation_failed_search_origin.description:
A deployed slave miner whose long scan finds no field, or whose site
search finds no site, still makes the F7 comparison with cell (0, 0)
for the missing result; off: either failure leaves it deployed.

slow_walker_stall.description: A walker of speed 1 heading between east and south stalls.
