smoke_deck_extra_update.description: A smoke particle stopped at a bridge deck takes one more update with its draws and is removed (with its successors) in the next turn; off: it is removed in the pass that stops it, with no further update draws (`glasnost_sim::particles`).

smoke_ignores_particle_cap.description: A smoke system emits however many particles it holds, whatever its type's particle-cap field; off: while it holds as many particles as the cap, an emission takes its two raw values and grows the timer but makes no particle (`glasnost_sim::particles`).

smudge_footprints_beyond_map_edge.description:
A smudge footprint cell beyond the map edge is tested as a
placeholder cell that holds nothing and has the theater's first tile
type; off: a footprint beyond the map edge does not fit.

sound_order_startup_draw.description: Immediate-mode random ordering with no attack sample takes and discards one startup ordering draw; off: no discarded draw.

spark_double_gravity.description: A spark's vertical step counts gravity twice in a tick, its stored vertical velocity once; off: the step uses the stored vertical velocity (`glasnost_sim::particles`).

spawner_pending_target_survives_idle_cle.description: An own-target clear empties the pending target only when the controller target is nonempty, so a pending shot can survive the clear and launch later; off: every explicit own-target clear empties the pending target.

speed_normalised_delays.description: Game speed reaches game state through speed-normalised delays and a chrono flash stepping in frozen cycles.

spent_route_blocks_join.description:
An object keeps its route record once its route is empty, so a
route-mode click on a point its route does not hold is refused and it
never joins a point again (the original). Off: an empty route counts
as no route record.

spread_attempts_count_failures.description: Failed spread attempts count and the cell returns to the front of the list.

spread_mark_kept_on_last_neighbour.description: A cell dropped from the spread list with one free neighbour can rejoin only through a rebuilding.

spread_offer_by_emptied_type.description: Neighbours of an emptied cell join the emptied cell's tiberium's spread list.

spread_ring_eleven.description: A scan radius of 11 uses the original's ring-11 list (one cell twice, some cells missing).

spread_stage_from_index.description: The stage a cell needs to spread depends on the tiberium's index.

spread_step_lost_on_terrain_object.description:
A cell holding a terrain object (a tree) counts as germinable; when a spread step or an
ore mine chooses it, it receives nothing and the spread step's attempt is used. Off: such
a cell is not germinable, so a spread step passes over it and it does not count in *c*.

spy_plane_count_from_paradrop_list.description: The spy plane count is the length of the first side group's paradrop infantry list, and none when that list and its count list differ in length; off: exactly one plane.

spy_satellite_first_building_decides.description: Only the first qualifying spy-satellite building is looked at.

spy_theft_unbacked_gain.description: A spy's thief gains the computed amount even when the victim pays less or the amount is negative; off: the amount is clamped to between 0 and the victim's balance.

stacked_point_takes_earliest.description:
Where several points of the house stand at one place, a press takes
the earliest-made of them, and its orders name the place (the
original). Off: with objects selected, the press takes the
earliest-made one a selected route holds, else the earliest-made,
and its orders name that point itself.

stale_chargers_kept.description: A building of a non-overpowerable type never removes chargers that stopped aiming at it; off: it removes them as an overpowerable type does.

stale_fill_tiles.description: The fill uses the base tiles of the theater loaded before.

stale_offer_orderable.description: A type left in the offer after it stopped qualifying can be ordered until the next recheck.

stale_suspended_revert.description: Start-next and force leave the suspended behaviour and the put-aside target and destination in place, so a late revert can bring them back; off: an effective start-next or force empties them.

start_waypoint_gap.description: The start list skips undefined start waypoints and K stops at the first gap; off: position i is waypoint i whenever it is defined.

starting_infantry_share_centre.description: A starting infantry unit stands at its cell's centre position whatever infantry already stand there, with no draw; off: it takes a standing position by S-0208 claim 3, with that claim's draw.

stationary_friendly_exactly_three.description: Stationary friendly needs exactly three allied infantry without movement in progress.

stored_target_point.description: Arrival, pass-by, same-cell and in-flight line-of-fire rows use the point stored at placement.

substitution_centre_ground_level.description: Destination substitution judges heights around the ground of a bridge-cell destination.

substitution_distance_flat_destination.description: Destination substitution measures to the destination cell at world height 0.

superweapon_block_one_layer.description: In a high-bridge cell of an effect block only the deck layer's objects are reached, elsewhere only the ground layer's; off: both layers of a high-bridge cell are reached, deck-layer effects first.

superweapon_grant_suspends_by_house_powe.description: A superweapon granted by buildings while its house has low power starts suspended, whether or not the type is power-dependent, and no other condition suspends it at the grant; off: the grant suspends exactly when the claim 6 test would.

superweapon_kind_as_list_position.description: The silo's weapon, a teleport-source pick's armed type and the radar's superweapon offers use a kind number as a position in the superweapon type list; off: each uses the type of that kind.

superweapon_list_cut_by_removal.description: When a reached object leaves its cell immediately during its own effect, later listed objects in that cell are not reached; off: objects listed when the effect begins stay eligible.

superweapon_order_first_type_of_action.description: A superweapon fire order fires the first type in list order whose aim action is the selected type's; off: it fires the selected type.

superweapon_order_tests_clock.description: A fire order needs a granted, ready record whose clock is running; off: it needs a granted, ready record that is not suspended.

superweapon_restart_ignores_suspension.description: A second-stage launch and a set-charge action start the clock running even on a suspended record; off: a suspended record's clock stays stopped at the new remaining time.

superweapon_setting_tests_first_only.description: The superweapon setting's build bar tests only a building type's first superweapon.

superweapon_upgrade_second_removal_waits.description: Removing an upgrade makes the immediate superweapon availability check only when the upgrade names a first superweapon; off: an upgrade naming either superweapon field makes it.

switched_off_hover_lead.description: A switched-off hovering vehicle that S-0503 counts as moving is led.

tab_flash_initial_extra_period.description: A tab flash starts with an extra 10-update period; off: the first toggle comes at the next 10-tick boundary.

table_direction.description: Directions follow the tabulated arctangent and the short facing scale; off: the exact angle.

table_root_distance.description: Distances use the table square root; off: the exact integer square root.

table_trig_negative_bias.description: The table sine and cosine of a negative angle can land two steps short.

teleport_aircraft_ground_reservation.description: A teleporting aircraft reserves its landing cell's ground object-present flag, keeps it through deck placement and clears only actual deck occupancy on removal; off: reserve and clear only the eventual landing layer.

teleport_infantry_ground_reservation.description: A teleporting infantry unit's ground standing-position reservation is left behind by deck placement, and a later destination choice clears by its actual position and height; off: the reservation moves to the actual landing surface at the jump.

teleport_infantry_negative_level_entry.description: A teleporting infantry unit's landing entry check takes a cell at terrain level −6 or lower as clear without testing terrain or occupants; off: the ordinary landing entry check applies.

teleport_vehicle_ground_reservation.description: A teleporting vehicle reserves the ground record of its landing cell even on a high bridge, remembers that point for later clearing and keeps the ground reservation through deck placement, which also marks deck; off: reserve and clear the eventual landing layer only.

thinning_hits_waypoint_only.description: The waypoint-thinning action takes every bale from the waypoint's own cell only.

threat_rebuild_counts_friends.description: The rebuild of a house's threat records counts its own and its allies' objects.

top_position_counts_as_centre.description: A unit standing at the top position is recorded as taking the centre.

track_body_turn_stops_at_target.description: A turret-less track-class body turn that passes exactly through its target's direction stops there.

train_exclusion_search_only.description: The exclusion of the cells behind a train holds for the search only.

transport_load_truncated.description: A passenger adds its size rounded down to the transport's load; off: the size is kept unrounded.

tread_default_water_only.description: The tread entry is used for no current sequence on water only, not beach.

trigger_crate_expiry_while_disabled.description: Off (the original): an uncollected trigger crate never expires while crates are off; on: it expires after its assigned lifetime. Not consulted yet (crates, S-0520, are not built).

trigger_crate_respects_setting.description: Off (the original): the create-crate action ignores the crate setting; on: it has no effect while crates are off. Not consulted yet (crates, S-0520, are not built).

turn_rate_negative_wrap.description: A negative turn-rate field acts through its remainder modulo 256.

turret_reaim_after_turn.description: A turret still turning at the end of the previous tick is not re-aimed by the target rows.

turret_snap_bound_wraps.description: A turreted building's turret snap bound reads the turn-rate field as a signed value modulo 256; off: the bound is 256 times the turn rate S-0206 gives for the field.

turret_spin_quantised.description: A spinning turret turns by the quantised steps of claim 11.

two_sound_cues.description: At most two sound cues per sequence entry.

unarmed_pad_bound_hover.description: An unarmed pad-bound aircraft with dock types that falls back to rest in flight with no contact makes no pad search: it takes an F8 landing spot and move, and hovers there; off: T2's last in-flight row first looks for a pad and asks it for contact, and when the pad grants it, it takes the pad as destination with enter and docks; otherwise the landing spot and move, with no crash. Only a landable type is affected.

unchecked_substitute.description: A substituted sequence kind is not checked for an empty frame count.

uncloak_from_cloaking_full_duration.description: An uncloak started while cloaking takes the full duration; off: it starts from the current stage.

uncounted_sight.description: The original applies an uncounted sight at a few moments, never removed.

undemolishable_heal_is_damage.description: The minimum of 1 on an undemolishable building applies to every hit no row stops, so healing hits damage it.

ungranted_super_reads_clock.description:
A superweapon building's slots read the owner's record clock whether or not the record is
granted, so a record never granted reads 0 and the grand opening shows the charged
*super-3*; off: a record that is not granted counts as not charged (*super-1* at the
opening, and the charge check waits for the grant).

unit_changes_no_recheck.description: Unit entries, departures, owner changes and removals below the limit call for no recheck.

unload_facing_gap_no_wrap.description: The gap between a neighbour's direction and the rear facing is not taken the short way round; off: the short way.

unload_failed_exit_gunner_handover.description: A failed exit changes the gunner's weapon number to position 1's mode index; off: unchanged.

unload_second_round_skips_rear.description: The second unloading round starts one step clockwise of the rear; off: it tries the rear direction first.

unload_without_contact_stalls.description: A harvester whose refinery breaks off contact while it unloads, with nothing queued, stays in unload until an order gives it a behaviour.

unreachable_move_dropped.description:
A move whose destination cell fails the gate or the search is dropped
(the original). Off (our design, C7 part 4): the computation first
tries once more towards the nearest cell the unit can stand on in its
own reach region.

unscored_vehicle_stays_counted.description: A vehicle of a not-scored type is counted on entering the map and never taken off.

unset_role_range.description: An unset role's range still counts tile numbers from its unset start.

unstartable_queue_head_stalls.description: A queued type that cannot start is dropped and the line starts nothing more.

update_order_removal_skip.description: Each counting removal during the turn pass costs one later object its turn, and an object that re-enters play takes a second turn.

upgrade_attack_weapon_gate.description: A non-SAM building with an installed upgrade fires on a *can fire* answer only when its first installed upgrade's ordinary weapons pass the gate (a primary, and the same weapon in both slots or a burst count above 1); off: a failed gate permits the ordinary selected-weapon attempt.

upgrade_fields_carry_over.description: An absent upgrade name field of a map building entry keeps the type the same field named in an earlier entry; off: it means no upgrade.

upgrade_level_without_room.description: An upgrade is placed even when the target records nothing.

upgrade_prerequisite_last_building.description: An upgrade prerequisite examines only the most recently acquired eligible building.

uphill_arc_45.description: Arcing shots at a higher impact point are launched at 45 degrees.

vehicle_buildings_keep_nobody_alive.description: A building that counts as a vehicle keeps its house alive only when it is a refinery-list building.

vehicle_charge_no_break_off.description: A vehicle with an electric-charge secondary has no break-off search and keeps firing charge shots at the building while enemies approach; off: vehicles break off as infantry do.

vehicle_destruction_extra_raises.description: A vehicle's killing hit makes the extra destruction-raise group before the common group; off: only the common group, for every vehicle.

vertical_speed_uncapped.description: A vertical projectile's speed grows by its acceleration without a cap.

voxel_debris_cliff_step_faults.description: A debris piece's cliff turn on a north-east or south-west step examines the two cells behind the move with their faces swapped, and a north-west step with only the northern neighbour high gives (c, uₓ, u_y); off: those steps examine the cells beside the corner and the north-west case turns across y.

voxel_debris_deck_impact_layer.description: A debris piece's ground impact that the deck test puts on a high-bridge deck hits the cell's ground layer (the objects under the deck); off: it hits the deck layer of that cell, as a detonation on the deck does.

voxel_debris_deck_over_water.description: A debris piece's ground impact from a high-bridge cell over water is a water impact even on the deck (no bounce animation, no hit, the piece ends in its next turn); off: an impact the deck test puts at the deck height is treated as on land.

voxel_debris_deck_rebound_slope.description: A debris piece's contact on a high bridge's deck rebounds off the slope of the ground cell under the deck; off: a contact that the deck test puts at the deck height rebounds by the flat rule.

voxel_debris_expiry_needs_animation.description: A debris piece's end deals its area damage and light flash only when its type names an expiry animation; off: also when the damage amount is not 0.

voxel_debris_trailer_height.description: A debris piece's trailer animation is made at about 6.967 times the piece's height (F7); off: at the piece's flight point before the move.

voxel_turret_exact_aim.description: A building with a voxel turret must point exactly at its target.

walker_bridge_destination_deck.description: A walker's cell destination on a high-bridge cell aims at deck height (the centre's terrain height plus 414 leptons) whatever layer it arrives on; off: the arrival test uses the centre's height on the walker's arrival layer.

walker_overshoot.description: A fast walker can step past its walking target and swing back.

walker_targets_allied_wall.description: A walker that meets an allied wall with no object listed takes the wall as its target.

wall_cell_over_same_ring_object.description: A wall candidate wins over a candidate object later in the same ring.

wall_exception_skips_ground.description: A cell meeting a wall exception passes without the ground conditions of claim 3 (d).

wall_hit_minus_one_is_absolute.description: A wall hit of exactly -1 is absolute.

warp_deck_departure_airborne.description: A warp member that departed from a high-bridge deck counts as airborne for a projectile until it appears.

warp_departure_keeps_beam.description: A temporal projectile in flight at a superweapon warp's launch, or a fragment, locks a beam on a member; the warp and the erasure both go on, and from its departure the member is no longer being erased while the beam stays attached, up to a later lock; off: a pending warp, from the launch until the departure update, is one more lock refusal.

warp_hold_persists.description: A superweapon teleport's arrival hold uses the member's held delay, which nothing resets after a redirected landing; off: the hold is the teleport delay after a redirected landing and 0 otherwise, for each warp.

warp_kill_before_protection.description: A warp kills an organic object without the teleporter flag even when it is protected; off: a protected organic object is left alone.

warp_naval_road_cell.description: A naval warp member landing on a road cell sinks; off: a road cell that is water is not counted.

warp_redirect_as_tracked.description: A blocked warp landing searches with the track locomotion class and a simplified movement zone; off: with the member's own class and zone.

wind_southeast_short.description: Wind direction 3 pushes a gas particle 1 lepton in x instead of 2, unlike its mirror direction 5; off: Δx = 2 for direction 3.

yellow_state_at_half.description: The yellow damage state is reported at half the strength, whatever the yellow ratio.

zero_capacity_harvester_cycles.description: A vehicle harvester type with capacity 0 runs its cycle without ever carrying a bale (fill ratio 0/0); off: imported capacity 0 counts as 1 bale.

zero_distance_arc.description: An arcing shot at a point exactly below the fire point uses F4's zero-distance rule.

zero_kill_value_caps.description: A kill value of 0 against an actual cost of 0 sets experience to the cap.

zero_load_period_stalls.description: A load period of 0 keeps the harvester loading for good after its first bale.

zero_rate_freezes_ambient.description: With a zero ambient change rate the current ambient never moves, even for nuke and dominator fades; off: it jumps straight to the target.

zero_score_rejected.description: A final threat score of exactly 0 rejects the candidate.

zero_speed_launch.description: A start speed of 0 launches at a horizontal speed of 100.
